author: clee30
title: Android CMake configure fails: MODULE_LIBRARY plugins cannot be linked via ov_generate_plugins_hpp
signature: target of type MODULE LIBRARY may not be linked into another target in ov generate plugins hpp|Code Issue
failed_jobs: Build arm64 — CMake configure failed: MODULE_LIBRARY targets cannot be linked
Build x64 — CMake configure failed: MODULE_LIBRARY targets cannot be linked
key_errors: CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 (target_link_libraries): Target "openvino_intel_gpu_plugin" of type MODULE_LIBRARY may not be linked into another target.
root_cause: The Android CMake configure step fails because ov_generate_plugins_hpp() attempts to call target_link_libraries() on MODULE_LIBRARY plugin targets (e.g., openvino_intel_gpu_plugin, openvino_intel_cpu_plugin). MODULE_LIBRARY targets cannot be linked like SHARED libraries. This is a pre-existing recurring issue in the Android build (seen 5+ times since 2026-08-08) unrelated to PR #37056's GPU/SDPA changes, which only touch GPU plugin implementation files.
reproduction_steps: Run the Android CMake configure step locally with the Android NDK toolchain.
recommended_actions: Investigate cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 — the ov_generate_plugins_hpp() call that links MODULE_LIBRARY targets
Fix the CMake logic to skip or handle MODULE_LIBRARY plugins differently (e.g., guard with get_target_property TYPE check)
This appears to be a pre-existing infrastructure/CMake bug in the Android build, not introduced by PR #37056
prevention_strategies: Guard target_link_libraries in ov_generate_plugins_hpp with a CMake TYPE check to skip MODULE_LIBRARY targets.
historical_context: This exact same CMake error has been observed 5 times starting 2026-08-08 across multiple unrelated PRs, indicating a systemic Android build infrastructure issue.
